correctness.rationale: PASS: For positive masses a,b,c and three distinct ordered support points, the standardized moment Gram determinant det E[(1,Y,Y²)^T(1,Y,Y²)] = kappa-gamma²-1. Determinant of W^T diag(a,b,c)W gives abc times squared three-point Vandermonde divided by variance³, proving exact positive gap. Pairwise variance identity gives V(r)=ab r²+ac(1+r)²+bc, with r>0. I independently symbolically differentiated G=abc r²(1+r)²/V³ and verified G'=-2abc r(1+r)P/V⁴ with published cubic P=a(b+c)r³+a(2b+c)r²-c(a+2b)r-c(a+b). Its signs +,+,-,- and limits P(0)<0, P(infinity)>0 imply exactly one positive root and unique global maximum; endpoint gap tends zero but never attained. For a=b=c=1/3, P=(r-1)(r+2)(2r+1)/9 and G(1)=1/2, hence 1<kappa-gamma²<=3/2. Source checker performs exact rational finite checks, but infinite conclusion is algebraic, not experimentally inferred.
